svg.title: HopCharlie 기술 스택
svg.desc: Cloud & Runtime: Amazon EKS, EC2, S3, Google GKE, Cloud Storage, K3s, Tailscale. Development: Go, React, TypeScript, Vite. CI/CD & Provisioning: GitHub Actions, Docker, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD. Data & Migration: PostgreSQL, CloudNativePG, rclone, MinIO. AI & Observability: Claude, OpenTelemetry, ClickStack, Prometheus, Langfuse.
